findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 is not fully covered: packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:140 records candidate-trial outcome rows and packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:162 records matched-control rows directly, but the smoke never invokes playbook_promotion_status to prove the required status reporting path. The current status handler only builds pendingLearning from outcome aggregates at packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1093 and does not expose/verify matched-control reporting, so the evidence note overclaims promotion status coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: playbook_promotion_status now reads playbook-trial-controls.jsonl, emits trialControlSummary in JSON/text, and playbook-trial-automation-smoke proves status reports one candidate-trial outcome and one matched-control row after registered playbook_trial_run --apply. Evidence: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-seed-backfill-smoke.js; command catalog/ownership/process fact checks all passed.

findings.desc: Command registration coverage is missing for the new B-5f5b command surfaces: the new smokes call core builders directly (packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-seed-backfill-smoke.ts:181 and packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:140,206) instead of dispatching playbook_seed_backfill/playbook_trial_run/playbook_promotion_timer through CLI or createMainRegistry. The existing registration smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-seed-promotion-loop-smoke.ts:1449 lists earlier playbook commands but omits playbook_seed_backfill, playbook_trial_run, and playbook_promotion_timer, so validation does not prove MAIN_TOOLS/registry/COMMAND_POLICIES/PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS wiring for these new commands.
findings.resolvedReason: playbook-trial-automation-smoke now instantiates createMainRegistry, executes playbook_trial_run and playbook_promotion_timer through registered handlers, and asserts playbook_seed_backfill, playbook_trial_run, and playbook_promotion_timer are present in MAIN_TOOLS, registry, COMMAND_POLICIES, READ_ONLY_COMMANDS classification, phase allowlist, and PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS. Evidence: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.js; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract; npm run test:process-fact-contract.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1077 MEDIUM: playbook_promotion_status builds its payload from outcome/decision/seed/runtime data but never reads the new matched-control ledger or renders trial/control counts, so CHK-002 happy path claim that promotion status reports concrete trial exposure and matched-control rows is not satisfied; only playbook_trial_run reports those counts.
findings.resolvedReason: playbook_promotion_status now reads the matched-control ledger with diagnostics and renders trialControlSummary counts: outcomeTrialExposureRows, matchedControlRows, malformedOutcomeRows, malformedControlRows, candidate/control playbook counts, and per-playbook rows in text and JSON. Evidence: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.js; command catalog/ownership/process fact checks all passed.

findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 disabled action reporting is not actually covered in the current smoke. packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:224 runs playbook_promotion_timer with backfill/sweep unrequested, but the assertions around lines 232-236 and 248-251 only check trial/activate statuses. The smoke never asserts that unrequested backfill/sweep steps are present with status=disabled and messages such as the implementation branches at packages/main/src/core/playbook-seed.ts:2339 and packages/main/src/core/playbook-seed.ts:2418. This would pass if the timer silently omitted disabled actions, so the evidence note overclaims CHK-003 disabled action reporting coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: playbook-trial-automation-smoke now asserts unrequested timer backfill and sweep steps are present in both dry-run and apply reports with requested=false, status=disabled, applied=false, matching dryRun mode, and exact 'step not requested' messages. Evidence: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.js passed with 3/3 checks after commit 9a718ffb1.
